styleLock.backgroundSystem: one surface family per shot: seamless #FFFFFF studio field, cool milk info panel #F6F8F7, pale lime-plaster block #E9EDEC, or soft aqua tint #DCEFF4 as the only graphic block; never photographic scenery inside an infographic panel
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright cool key from the front-left with a broad soft fill, crisp but short contact shadow under the bucket foot, 5500-6000K, glossy mouth rim gets one clean specular line only, no warm cast
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte pale lime-plaster pedestal #E9EDEC and smooth cool porcelain floor #DDE3E2, bucket body rendered as matte injection-moulded plastic with a fine grain, never glossy vinyl
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family for all rendered Chinese and Latin text; two-tone headlines where the first two characters sit in #2FB2CC and the rest in #242A2C; headline 28-48pt, subtitle 16-20pt, label 10-14pt; Chinese copy always wrapped in 「」 and supplied as placeholders
styleLock.iconSystem: single-weight thin line icons in #242A2C inside a 1px circle, plus solid #2FB2CC numerals for numbered rows; no emoji, no 3D badges, no shield or medal artwork
styleLock.presentationRules: floor-standing bucket only, base always in true contact with its surface; the mouth ring and the oval bag slot under it must be legible in at least three shots; consistent slight-taper silhouette across the set; identical bucket scale when variants sit in one row
noDrift: no lids, pedals, sensors or swing tops added to an open-top bucket
no source brand wordmark, membership badge or QR code
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean #FFFFFF, cool milk info panel #F6F8F7, deep charcoal text #242A2C and one aqua accent #2FB2CC (or {accent_color} when a brand hue is supplied) with #DCEFF4 as the only soft secondary tint; cool 5500-6000K studio lighting with a bright front-left key, broad soft fill and short crisp contact shadows under the bucket foot; one modern geometric sans-serif family for every rendered Chinese and Latin label, two-tone headlines with the first two characters in #2FB2CC, headline 28-48pt and label 10-14pt, Chinese copy wrapped in 「」; background system of seamless #FFFFFF, cool milk panel #F6F8F7, pale lime-plaster block #E9EDEC and soft aqua tint #DCEFF4, one surface family per shot; layout system of a centred eyebrow pill above a two-tone headline, hairline rules broken by one small circle node, zig-zag alternating two-column rows led by solid aqua numerals, and a chip-label spec table with dimension leader lines; icon system of single-weight thin line icons in #242A2C inside 1px circles; product presentation stays floor-standing with a true contact shadow, the mouth ring and oval bag slot legible, and identical scale across the set; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 由 8 张详情页切片提炼，仅保留镜位/光位/背景体系与信息图版式等可复用视觉语法。已剥离：拉丁字母装饰副标 FAMILY STORAGE BARRELS、全部原文案（改为 {selling_point_*} / {callout_*} 占位）、左下角「加入会员 全店免费」角标与二维码。品类判定按图不按源夹名：图为无盖直筒锥度塑料桶，口部一圈深色压圈夹住垃圾袋、压圈下方一枚开孔提手、底部加高，非脚踏、非感应、非壁挂、非分类多格、非带轮，故归 家居日用 / 家务工具（垃圾桶属家用清洁器具），leaf 写作无盖压圈塑料垃圾桶。多张切片中的产品图为全黑占位图，无法核对细节，因此模版只保留可读到的结构事实（无盖、压圈、开孔提手、锥度桶身、加高底、多配色、PP 注塑哑光面），细节以 {product_identity_lock} 交回真实产品图判定。原图中的环保/无毒无气味/易清洗等材质与安全声明、六色可选的确切色名、尺寸数字与品名表均脱敏为占位符，未写入任何升数、毫米、材质牌号或证书叙述。原图第 4 片为双手捧 PP 颗粒，属易翻车的模特手部镜头，已改为不生成手部、并在各镜头 negative 中禁手。与同库 jiajuriyong-miandaikong-bigua-shounazhiwujia 的差别：本模版为落地式桶具、冷调水青体系、居中胶囊眉标加两色大标题与折线编号行的版式；后者为壁挂收纳、中性暖灰加橡木强调、左上文字块与细线图标体系。
